title: Nisbiy (aniqlovchi) ergash gaplar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida who, which, that, whose, where va when yordamida odam, narsa va joyni aniqlab yoki unga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot berib tasvirlaysiz, vergulni to‘g‘ri qo‘yasiz va ikki qisqa gapni bitta ravon gapga birlashtirasiz.

vocab.uz: ki / -gan (odam va narsa uchun, aniqlovchi gapda)

scenes.title: Xush kelibsiz
board: Relative clauses
(Nisbiy ergash gaplar)
who · which · that · whose · where · when
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda majhul nisbatni, ya’ni “The bridge was built in 1990” kabi gaplarni o‘rgandik: ish-harakatni kim qilgani emas, nima bo‘lgani muhim edi. Bugun esa nutqingizni ancha boyitadigan mavzu: nisbiy ergash gaplar. Dars oxirida odam, narsa yoki joyni bitta uzun, aniq gap bilan tasvirlay olasiz, masalan “the teacher who helped me most” va qisqa gaplarni ravon bitta gapga birlashtirasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we're going to learn how to give more information about people, things and places in a single sentence. For example: This is the teacher who changed my life. By the end of the lesson, your English will sound much more fluent and connected.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun odamlar, narsalar va joylar haqida bitta gapda ko‘proq ma’lumot berishni o‘rganamiz. Masalan: Bu mening hayotimni o‘zgartirgan o‘qituvchi. Dars oxirida ingliz tilingiz ancha ravon va bog‘langan eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Nisbiy gap nima?
board: the man [who lives next door]
(qo‘shnimiz bo‘lib yashaydigan odam)
noun + relative clause

examples.t: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
I read the book that you gave me.

scenes.say_native: Nisbiy ergash gap otga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradigan kichik gap. O‘zbek tilida biz buni sifatdosh bilan qilamiz: “qo‘shnimizda yashaydigan odam”, “siz bergan kitob”. E’tibor bering: o‘zbekchada tasvir otdan oldin keladi. Ingliz tilida esa aksincha: avval ot, keyin who, which yoki that, undan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: “the man who lives next door”. Turk tilida ham “-an”, “-dık” qo‘shimchalari xuddi o‘zbekchadagidek ishlaydi, shuning uchun bu tartib bizga g‘alati tuyuladi.
scenes.say: A relative clause is a small sentence inside a bigger one. It comes right after a noun and tells us more about it. The man who lives next door is a doctor. I read the book that you gave me.
scenes.say_uz: Nisbiy gap katta gap ichidagi kichik gap. U otdan darhol keyin keladi va u haqida ko‘proq aytadi. Qo‘shnimizda yashaydigan odam shifokor. Siz bergan kitobni o‘qidim.

scenes.title: Odamlar uchun: who / that
board: people → who / that
the girl who won the prize
(sovrinni yutgan qiz)

examples.t: She's the girl who won the prize.
I know a man that speaks six languages.
examples.uz: Olti tilda gapiradigan bir odamni bilaman.

examples.t: Doctors who work at night get tired.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoida: gap odam haqida bo‘lsa, “who” ishlatamiz. Og‘zaki nutqda “that” ham mumkin, lekin odamlar uchun “who” tabiiyroq va xavfsizroq tanlov. Diqqat qiling: “who” bu yerda savol emas. “Who is she?” savolidagi “kim” ma’nosi emas, balki ikki gapni bog‘lovchi so‘z. “The girl who won the prize” — “sovrinni yutgan qiz”. “Who” dan keyin darhol fe’l kelyapti, chunki “who” gapning egasi vazifasini bajaryapti.
scenes.say: When we talk about people, we use who. In informal English, that is also possible. She's the girl who won the prize. I know a man that speaks six languages. Doctors who work at night often get tired.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar haqida gapirganda who ishlatamiz. Norasmiy ingliz tilida that ham mumkin. U sovrinni yutgan qiz. Olti tilda gapiradigan bir odamni bilaman. Kechasi ishlaydigan shifokorlar ko‘pincha charchaydi.

scenes.title: Narsalar uchun: which / that
board: things & animals → which / that
the bus which goes to the airport
(aeroportga boradigan avtobus)

examples.t: This is the bus which goes to the airport.
I lost the phone that I bought last week.
examples.uz: O‘tgan hafta sotib olgan telefonimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim.

examples.t: We have a cat which sleeps all day.
examples.uz: Bizda kun bo‘yi uxlaydigan mushuk bor.

scenes.say_native: Narsalar va hayvonlar uchun “which” yoki “that” ishlatamiz. Britaniya ingliz tilida ikkalasi ham keng ishlatiladi. Amerikaliklar esa aniqlovchi gaplarda ko‘proq “that” ni afzal ko‘radi, “which” ni asosan vergulli gaplarda qo‘llaydi. Siz ikkalasini ham ishlatishingiz mumkin, xato bo‘lmaydi. Asosiysi: odam uchun “which” emas, narsa uchun “who” emas. O‘zbekchada bunday farq yo‘q, “yutgan qiz” ham, “ketgan avtobus” ham bir xil “-gan” bilan yasaladi.
scenes.say: For things and animals, we use which or that. This is the bus which goes to the airport. I lost the phone that I bought last week. We have a cat which sleeps all day.
scenes.say_uz: Narsalar va hayvonlar uchun which yoki that ishlatamiz. Bu aeroportga boradigan avtobus. O‘tgan hafta sotib olgan telefonimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim. Bizda kun bo‘yi uxlaydigan mushuk bor.

scenes.title: Ko‘proq misollar
board: people → who
things → which
both → that

examples.t: The woman who cuts my hair is from Bukhara.
Plov is a dish which everybody loves.
The students that passed the exam were happy.

scenes.say_native: Endi misollarni tinglang va har birida otni hamda undan keyingi nisbiy olmoshni toping. “The woman” — odam, shuning uchun “who”. “A dish” — narsa, shuning uchun “which”. “The students” — odamlar, lekin bu yerda “that” ishlatildi, bu ham to‘g‘ri. Har bir gapda o‘zbekcha tarjimaga qarang: ingliz tilidagi butun nisbiy gap o‘zbekchada otdan oldin bitta sifatdoshli birikmaga aylanadi. Bu ikki tilning eng katta farqlaridan biri.
scenes.say: Listen. The woman who cuts my hair is from Bukhara. Plov is a dish which everybody loves. The students that passed the exam were really happy.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Sochimni oladigan ayol Buxorodan. Palov hamma yaxshi ko‘radigan taom. Imtihondan o‘tgan talabalar juda xursand edi.

scenes.title: So‘z tartibi: o‘zbekcha va inglizcha
board: UZ: [kecha tanishgan] qiz
EN: the girl [I met yesterday]
noun FIRST → then the clause

examples.t: the girl I met yesterday
the city where my parents live

scenes.say_native: Keling, tartibni aniq solishtiraylik. O‘zbekchada: “kecha tanishgan qiz”. Avval tasvir, oxirida ot. Inglizchada: “the girl I met yesterday”. Avval ot, keyin tasvir. Shuning uchun tarjima qilganda gapni oxiridan boshlang: avval kim yoki nima haqida gapirayotganingizni ayting, keyin u haqidagi ma’lumotni qo‘shing. Rus tilini bilsangiz, sizga oson: “девушка, которую я встретил” ham xuddi ingliz tilidagidek tartibda. “Который” taxminan “who” va “which” vazifasini bajaradi.
scenes.say: In English, the noun always comes first, and the information follows. The girl I met yesterday. The city where my parents live. Don't put the description before the noun.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida ot har doim birinchi keladi, ma’lumot esa undan keyin. Kecha tanishgan qiz. Ota-onam yashaydigan shahar. Tasvirni otdan oldin qo‘ymang.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha olmosh
board: ✗ The man who he lives here...
✓ The man who lives here...
✗ The book which I read it
✓ The book which I read
scenes.say_native: Juda keng tarqalgan xato: nisbiy olmoshdan keyin yana “he”, “she” yoki “it” qo‘shish. “The man who he lives here” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “who” ning o‘zi “he” vazifasini bajaryapti. Xuddi shunday “the book which I read it” ham xato, chunki “which” allaqachon “it” o‘rnida turibdi. Qoida oddiy: “who”, “which” yoki “that” bitta olmoshning o‘rnini egallaydi, ikkinchisini qo‘shmang. O‘zbekchada bunday olmosh umuman yo‘qligi uchun miya ikkalasini ham qo‘shib yuboradi.
scenes.say: Be careful. Don't repeat the pronoun. The man who lives here, not the man who he lives here. The book which I read, not the book which I read it.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling. Olmoshni takrorlamang. The man who lives here, the man who he lives here emas. The book which I read, the book which I read it emas.

scenes.title: What emas, which/that
board: ✗ the book what I bought
✓ the book which/that I bought
✗ the doctor which helped me
✓ the doctor who helped me
scenes.say_native: Yana ikkita xato. Birinchisi: otdan keyin “what” ishlatish. “The book what I bought” noto‘g‘ri. “What” otdan keyin nisbiy olmosh sifatida ishlatilmaydi, bu yerda “which” yoki “that” kerak. “What” ning o‘zi “the thing that” degan ma’noni beradi, masalan “I don’t understand what you mean”. Ikkinchi xato: odam uchun “which”. “The doctor which helped me” emas, “the doctor who helped me”. Rus tilida “который” hamma uchun bir xil bo‘lgani sababli ham bu xato tez-tez uchraydi.
scenes.say: We never use what after a noun. Say the book which I bought, or the book that I bought. And for people, use who: the doctor who helped me.
scenes.say_uz: Otdan keyin hech qachon what ishlatmaymiz. The book which I bought yoki the book that I bought deng. Odamlar uchun esa who: the doctor who helped me.

scenes.title: who yoki which?
board: 1. the boy ___ broke the window
2. the film ___ won an Oscar
3. a shop ___ sells old books
4. the nurse ___ looked after me
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz bajaring. Ekranda to‘rtta birikma bor. Har biriga “who” yoki “which” ni tanlang. Avval otga qarang: odammi yoki narsa? Keyin to‘liq birikmani ovoz chiqarib ayting. Masalan, birinchisi: “the boy … broke the window”. Pauza vaqtida to‘rttasini ham ayting.
scenes.say: Choose who or which. One: the boy, blank, broke the window. Two: the film, blank, won an Oscar. Three: a shop, blank, sells old books. Four: the nurse, blank, looked after me.
scenes.say_uz: Who yoki which ni tanlang. Bir: derazani sindirgan bola. Ikki: Oskar yutgan film. Uch: eski kitoblar sotadigan do‘kon. To‘rt: menga qaragan hamshira.

scenes.title: Javoblar: who / which
board: 1. the boy who broke the window
2. the film which won an Oscar
3. a shop which sells old books
4. the nurse who looked after me
scenes.say_native: Javoblarni tekshiring. Birinchi: “boy” odam, demak “who”. Ikkinchi: “film” narsa, demak “which”. Uchinchi: “shop” ham narsa, “which”. To‘rtinchi: “nurse”, ya’ni hamshira odam, “who”. Agar hammasida “that” desangiz ham, grammatik jihatdan xato bo‘lmasdi. Lekin bugun “who” va “which” farqini his qilish muhim, chunki vergulli gaplarda “that” ishlatib bo‘lmaydi. Buni birozdan keyin ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: One: the boy who broke the window. Two: the film which won an Oscar. Three: a shop which sells old books. Four: the nurse who looked after me.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: derazani sindirgan bola. Ikki: Oskar yutgan film. Uch: eski kitoblar sotadigan do‘kon. To‘rt: menga qaragan hamshira.

scenes.title: Egalik: whose
board: whose = his / her / their / its
the man whose car was stolen
(mashinasi o‘g‘irlangan odam)

examples.t: That's the man whose car was stolen.
I have a friend whose father is a pilot.

scenes.say_native: Endi “whose”. U egalikni bildiradi va “his”, “her”, “their” yoki “its” o‘rnida turadi. O‘zbekchada buni egalik qo‘shimchasi bilan aytamiz: “mashinasi o‘g‘irlangan odam”, “otasi uchuvchi bo‘lgan do‘stim”. Inglizchada: “the man whose car was stolen”. “Whose” dan keyin har doim ot keladi: “whose car”, “whose father”. Talaffuzi “who’s”, ya’ni “who is” bilan bir xil: /huːz/. Lekin yozuvda farq qiladi, shuning uchun yozganda ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: Whose shows possession. It replaces his, her or their. That's the man whose car was stolen. I have a friend whose father is a pilot. After whose, we always need a noun.
scenes.say_uz: Whose egalikni ko‘rsatadi. U his, her yoki their o‘rnida turadi. Bu mashinasi o‘g‘irlangan odam. Otasi uchuvchi bo‘lgan do‘stim bor. Whose dan keyin doim ot kerak.

scenes.title: Joy va vaqt: where / when
board: place → where
time → when
the café where we first met

examples.t: This is the café where we first met.
examples.uz: Bu biz ilk bor uchrashgan kafe.

examples.t: I remember the day when I started school.
Summer is the season when I feel happiest.
examples.uz: Yoz men eng baxtli his qiladigan fasl.

scenes.say_native: Joy haqida gapirganda “where”, vaqt haqida gapirganda “when” ishlatamiz. “The café where we first met” — “biz ilk bor uchrashgan kafe”. “The day when I started school” — “maktabga borgan kunim”. “When” ko‘pincha “the day”, “the year”, “the time” kabi so‘zlardan keyin keladi. Og‘zaki nutqda “when” ni tashlab ketish ham mumkin: “I remember the day I started school”. Bu juda tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: For places, use where. For times, use when. This is the café where we first met. I remember the day when I started school. Summer is the season when I feel happiest.
scenes.say_uz: Joylar uchun where, vaqt uchun when ishlating. Bu biz ilk bor uchrashgan kafe. Maktabga borgan kunimni eslayman. Yoz men eng baxtli his qiladigan fasl.

scenes.title: where yoki which?
board: ✗ the city where I visited
✓ the city which I visited
✓ the city where I live
(live in → where; visit + object → which)
scenes.say_native: Nozik bir xato. “Where” ni har bir joy nomidan keyin avtomatik qo‘ymang. Tekshiruv usuli: nisbiy gapdagi fe’lga qarang. “I live in the city” deymiz, ya’ni “in” bor, shuning uchun “the city where I live” to‘g‘ri. Lekin “I visited the city” deymiz, predlog yo‘q, shahar to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi. Shuning uchun “the city which I visited” yoki “the city I visited”. Qisqasi, “where” “in it” yoki “there” degan ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say: Where means in that place. So: the city where I live. But visit takes a direct object, so we say: the city which I visited, or simply, the city I visited.
scenes.say_uz: Where o‘sha joyda degan ma’noni beradi. Shuning uchun: men yashaydigan shahar. Lekin visit to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi, shuning uchun: men borgan shahar.

scenes.title: whose, where yoki when?
board: 1. the hotel ___ we stayed
2. a singer ___ songs are famous
3. the year ___ I was born
4. a girl ___ brother is my classmate
scenes.say_native: Navbatdagi mashq. To‘rtta bo‘sh joyga “whose”, “where” yoki “when” ni qo‘ying. Esda tuting: “whose” dan keyin ot keladi, “where” joy, “when” vaqt uchun. Birikmalarni to‘liq, baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Whose, where or when? One: the hotel, blank, we stayed. Two: a singer, blank, songs are famous. Three: the year, blank, I was born. Four: a girl, blank, brother is my classmate.
scenes.say_uz: Whose, where yoki when? Bir: biz turgan mehmonxona. Ikki: qo‘shiqlari mashhur qo‘shiqchi. Uch: men tug‘ilgan yil. To‘rt: akasi sinfdoshim bo‘lgan qiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: whose / where / when
board: 1. the hotel where we stayed
2. a singer whose songs are famous
3. the year when I was born
4. a girl whose brother is my classmate
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi: mehmonxona joy, “we stayed there”, shuning uchun “where”. Ikkinchi: “songs” ot, qo‘shiqlar qo‘shiqchiga tegishli, demak “whose”. Uchinchi: “the year”, vaqt, demak “when”. To‘rtinchi: “brother” ot va u qizga tegishli, “whose”. Agar to‘rttasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib. Asosiy olti nisbiy so‘zni bildingiz: who, which, that, whose, where va when.
scenes.say: One: the hotel where we stayed. Two: a singer whose songs are famous. Three: the year when I was born. Four: a girl whose brother is my classmate.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: biz turgan mehmonxona. Ikki: qo‘shiqlari mashhur qo‘shiqchi. Uch: men tug‘ilgan yil. To‘rt: akasi sinfdoshim bo‘lgan qiz.

scenes.title: Olmoshni tashlab ketish
board: the film (that) we watched
object → can omit
subject → must keep: the man who called

examples.t: The film (that) we watched was boring.
The man who called you is here.
examples.uz: Sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan odam shu yerda.

scenes.say_native: Endi muhim qoida. Ba’zan “who”, “which”, “that” ni tashlab ketish mumkin. Qachon? Agar olmoshdan keyin yangi ega kelsa, ya’ni olmosh to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lsa. “The film that we watched” — “that” dan keyin “we” bor, demak “that” ni olib tashlasa bo‘ladi: “the film we watched”. Lekin “the man who called you” da “who” dan keyin darhol fe’l keladi, “who” ega. Uni olib tashlab bo‘lmaydi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar og‘zaki nutqda olmoshni juda ko‘p tushirib qoldiradi.
scenes.say: Sometimes we can leave out the pronoun. If a new subject follows, we can drop it: the film we watched. But if the verb comes straight after, we must keep it: the man who called you.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zan olmoshni tushirib qoldirish mumkin. Agar undan keyin yangi ega kelsa, tashlab ketamiz: biz ko‘rgan film. Lekin darhol fe’l kelsa, saqlash shart: sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan odam.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutqda
board: the people I work with
the song you were singing
everything I need

examples.t: The people I work with are really friendly.
examples.uz: Men bilan ishlaydigan odamlar juda samimiy.

examples.t: What's the song you were singing?
This bag has everything I need.
examples.uz: Bu sumkada menga kerak bo‘lgan hamma narsa bor.

scenes.say_native: Kundalik suhbatda ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchilar olmoshni tushirib qoldirishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Tinglang: “the people I work with”, “the song you were singing”, “everything I need”. Har birida aslida “that” yashirin turibdi, lekin u aytilmaydi. Shuning uchun tinglayotganda ikki ot ketma-ket kelsa, masalan “the song you”, u yerda nisbiy gap boshlanayotganini tushuning. Bu tinglab tushunish uchun juda foydali ko‘nikma.
scenes.say: Native speakers often drop the pronoun in everyday speech. The people I work with are really friendly. What's the song you were singing? This bag has everything I need.
scenes.say_uz: Ona tili egalari kundalik nutqda olmoshni ko‘pincha tushirib qoldiradi. Men bilan ishlaydigan odamlar juda samimiy. Siz kuylayotgan qo‘shiq qaysi? Bu sumkada menga kerak bo‘lgan hamma narsa bor.

scenes.title: Egani tashlab bo‘lmaydi
board: ✗ I have a friend lives in Paris.
✓ I have a friend who lives in Paris.
✗ The bus goes to Chorsu is late.
✓ The bus that goes to Chorsu is late.
scenes.say_native: Teskari xato ham bor: kerakli olmoshni tushirib qoldirish. “I have a friend lives in Paris” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “lives” fe’lining egasi yo‘q bo‘lib qoladi. “Who” bu yerda ega, uni olib tashlab bo‘lmaydi: “I have a friend who lives in Paris”. Xuddi shunday “The bus goes to Chorsu is late” gapida ikkita fe’l bor va tinglovchi chalkashib ketadi. To‘g‘risi: “The bus that goes to Chorsu is late”. Fe’ldan oldin olmosh kerak.
scenes.say: Don't drop the pronoun when it's the subject. I have a friend who lives in Paris. The bus that goes to Chorsu is late.
scenes.say_uz: Olmosh ega bo‘lganda uni tushirib qoldirmang. Parijda yashaydigan do‘stim bor. Chorsuga boradigan avtobus kechikyapti.

scenes.title: Tashlab ketsa bo‘ladimi?
board: 1. the man who sold me this car
2. the cake that my mum made
3. the girl who I saw at the party
4. the road which leads to the river
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta birikma. Har birida olmoshni tashlab ketish mumkinmi yoki yo‘qmi? Agar mumkin bo‘lsa, birikmani olmoshsiz ayting. Maslahat: olmoshdan keyin nima turibdi, fe’lmi yoki yangi egami? Shunga qarang.
scenes.say: Can you leave out the pronoun? One: the man who sold me this car. Two: the cake that my mum made. Three: the girl who I saw at the party. Four: the road which leads to the river.
scenes.say_uz: Olmoshni tushirib qoldirsa bo‘ladimi? Bir: menga bu mashinani sotgan odam. Ikki: onam pishirgan tort. Uch: ziyofatda ko‘rgan qizim. To‘rt: daryoga olib boradigan yo‘l.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1. ✗ keep: the man who sold me…
2. ✓ the cake my mum made
3. ✓ the girl I saw at the party
4. ✗ keep: the road which leads…
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “who” dan keyin “sold”, fe’l keladi, demak “who” ega, uni saqlaymiz. Ikkinchi: “that” dan keyin “my mum”, yangi ega, demak tashlab ketish mumkin: “the cake my mum made”. Uchinchi: “who” dan keyin “I”, yana yangi ega: “the girl I saw at the party”. Aytgancha, bu gapda rasmiy uslubda “whom” ham uchraydi, lekin og‘zaki nutqda “who” yoki olmoshsiz shakl ishlatiladi. To‘rtinchi: “which” dan keyin “leads”, fe’l, saqlaymiz.
scenes.say: One: keep who. Two: the cake my mum made. Three: the girl I saw at the party. Four: keep which, because leads is a verb.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: who saqlanadi. Ikki: onam pishirgan tort. Uch: ziyofatda ko‘rgan qizim. To‘rt: which saqlanadi, chunki leads fe’l.

scenes.title: Aniqlovchi gap: vergulsiz
board: DEFINING = which one? (qaysi biri?)
no commas
The student who sits by the window is from Termez.

examples.t: The student who sits by the window is from Termez.
People who exercise sleep better.
examples.uz: Sport bilan shug‘ullanadigan odamlar yaxshiroq uxlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Endi darsning ikkinchi katta qismi: aniqlovchi va qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi gaplar farqi. Shu paytgacha ko‘rganlarimiz aniqlovchi gaplar edi. Ular “qaysi biri?” degan savolga javob beradi. Sinfda ko‘p talaba bor, qaysi biri? Deraza yonida o‘tirgani. Bu ma’lumotsiz gap tushunarsiz bo‘lib qoladi. “People who exercise sleep better” gapida ham “who exercise” ni olib tashlasak, “People sleep better” bo‘lib qoladi, ma’no butunlay o‘zgaradi. Aniqlovchi gaplarda vergul qo‘yilmaydi.
scenes.say: A defining clause tells us which person or thing we mean. Without it, the sentence is incomplete. The student who sits by the window is from Termez. People who exercise sleep better. No commas here.
scenes.say_uz: Aniqlovchi gap qaysi odam yoki narsani nazarda tutayotganimizni aytadi. Usiz gap to‘liq emas. Deraza yonida o‘tiradigan talaba Termizdan. Sport bilan shug‘ullanadigan odamlar yaxshiroq uxlaydi. Bu yerda vergul yo‘q.

scenes.title: Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot: vergul bilan
board: NON-DEFINING = extra info
, who / which / whose / where ,
My mother, who is a teacher, loves poetry.

examples.t: My mother, who is a teacher, loves poetry.
examples.uz: Onam, u o‘qituvchi, she’riyatni yaxshi ko‘radi.

examples.t: Samarkand, which is over 2,500 years old, attracts many tourists.
examples.uz: Samarqand, uning yoshi 2500 yildan oshgan, ko‘p sayyohlarni jalb qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi gap esa qaysi biri ekanini aniqlamaydi, biz allaqachon bilamiz. Mening onam bitta, Samarqand ham bitta. Vergul ichidagi qism shunchaki qo‘shimcha ma’lumot, uni olib tashlasak ham gap to‘liq qoladi: “My mother loves poetry”. Bunday gaplar vergul bilan ajratiladi, xuddi o‘zbek tilidagi kiritma gap kabi. Ular asosan yozma va rasmiyroq nutqda uchraydi. Ko‘pincha atoqli otlar, “my mother”, “my brother” kabi aniq odamlardan keyin keladi.
scenes.say: A non-defining clause just adds extra information. We already know who or what we mean. My mother, who is a teacher, loves poetry. Samarkand, which is over two and a half thousand years old, attracts many tourists.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi gap shunchaki ortiqcha ma’lumot qo‘shadi. Kim yoki nima haqida gapirayotganimizni allaqachon bilamiz. Onam, u o‘qituvchi, she’riyatni yaxshi ko‘radi. Samarqand, uning yoshi ikki ming besh yuz yildan oshgan, ko‘p sayyohlarni jalb qiladi.

scenes.title: Vergul ma’noni o‘zgartiradi
board: My brother who lives in London is a chef.
(bir nechta akam bor, Londondagisi)
My brother, who lives in London, is a chef.
(bitta akam bor, u Londonda yashaydi)
scenes.say_native: Qiziq misol. “My brother who lives in London is a chef” vergulsiz yozilsa, mening bir nechta akam borligini tushunasiz: Londonda yashaydigani oshpaz, boshqalari esa boshqa kasbda. “My brother, who lives in London, is a chef” vergul bilan yozilsa, akam bitta, u oshpaz, va aytgancha, Londonda yashaydi. Ko‘rdingizmi, ikkita vergul butun ma’noni o‘zgartirdi. Shuning uchun yozganda vergulni o‘ylab qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Listen to the difference. My brother who lives in London is a chef. So I have more than one brother. My brother, comma, who lives in London, comma, is a chef. So I have only one brother.
scenes.say_uz: Farqni tinglang. Londonda yashaydigan akam oshpaz. Demak, akam bittadan ko‘p. Akam, u Londonda yashaydi, oshpaz. Demak, faqat bitta akam bor.

scenes.title: Vergulli gapda that bo‘lmaydi
board: ✗ Tashkent, that is my home town, is huge.
✓ Tashkent, which is my home town, is huge.
✗ My dad, that is 60, ...
✓ My dad, who is 60, ...
scenes.say_native: Qat’iy qoida: vergulli gaplarda “that” ishlatilmaydi. “Tashkent, that is my home town” noto‘g‘ri. Faqat “which”: “Tashkent, which is my home town, is huge”. Odam uchun esa faqat “who”: “My dad, who is sixty”. Yana bir qoida: vergulli gapda olmoshni tushirib qoldirib bo‘lmaydi, hatto u to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lsa ham. “This book, which I bought in Bukhara, is old” gapida “which” ni olib tashlash mumkin emas.
scenes.say: In non-defining clauses, we never use that, and we never drop the pronoun. Tashkent, which is my home town, is huge. My dad, who is sixty, still plays football.
scenes.say_uz: Vergulli gaplarda hech qachon that ishlatmaymiz va olmoshni tushirib qoldirmaymiz. Toshkent, u mening ona shahrim, juda katta. Dadam, ular oltmish yoshda, hali ham futbol o‘ynaydi.

scenes.title: Butun gapga ishora: , which
board: …, which = and this
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
(…va bu hammani hayron qoldirdi)

examples.t: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
examples.uz: U imtihondan o‘tdi, bu esa hammani hayron qoldirdi.

examples.t: It rained all weekend, which was a pity.
examples.uz: Butun dam olish kunlari yomg‘ir yog‘di, bu achinarli bo‘ldi.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir foydali qo‘llanish. Vergul va “which” ba’zan bitta ot haqida emas, butun oldingi gap haqida gapiradi. “He passed the exam, which surprised everyone” — hammani hayron qoldirgan narsa imtihon emas, uning o‘tgani. O‘zbekchada buni “bu esa” deb tarjima qilamiz. Bu yerda “that” yoki “what” ishlatilmaydi. “It rained all weekend, which was a pity”. Bu tuzilma og‘zaki nutqda o‘z fikringizni qo‘shish uchun juda qulay.
scenes.say: Which can also refer to a whole idea. He passed the exam, which surprised everyone. It rained all weekend, which was a pity. Here which means and this.
scenes.say_uz: Which butun bir fikrga ham ishora qilishi mumkin. U imtihondan o‘tdi, bu esa hammani hayron qoldirdi. Butun dam olish kunlari yomg‘ir yog‘di, bu achinarli bo‘ldi. Bu yerda which va bu degan ma’noni beradi.

scenes.title: Vergul kerakmi?
board: 1. The phone which I use for work is old.
2. Navoi which is in the desert is very hot.
3. Teachers who are patient are the best.
4. My grandfather who was born in 1940 loves chess.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Qaysi gaplarga vergul kerak? O‘ylang: ma’lumot “qaysi biri?” savoliga javob beryaptimi yoki shunchaki qo‘shimcha ma’lumotmi? Agar odam yoki joy yagona bo‘lsa, masalan, shahar nomi yoki bobongiz, vergul kerak. Pauza vaqtida qaror qabul qiling.
scenes.say: Do these sentences need commas? One: The phone which I use for work is old. Two: Navoi which is in the desert is very hot. Three: Teachers who are patient are the best. Four: My grandfather who was born in nineteen forty loves chess.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarga vergul kerakmi? Bir: Ish uchun ishlatadigan telefonim eski. Ikki: Cho‘lda joylashgan Navoiy juda issiq. Uch: Sabrli o‘qituvchilar eng yaxshisi. To‘rt: 1940-yilda tug‘ilgan bobom shaxmatni yaxshi ko‘radi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: vergul
board: 1. no commas (which phone?)
2. Navoi, which is in the desert, is…
3. no commas (which teachers?)
4. My grandfather, who was born in 1940, …
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda vergul kerak emas: menda bir nechta telefon bor, ish uchun ishlatadiganim eski. Ikkinchida vergul kerak: Navoiy bitta shahar, cho‘lda ekanligi qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. Uchinchida vergul yo‘q: hamma o‘qituvchilar emas, faqat sabrlilari eng yaxshi. To‘rtinchida vergul kerak, chunki bobom aniq bir odam: “My grandfather, who was born in 1940, loves chess”. Ikki tomondan vergul qo‘yishni unutmang.
scenes.say: One: no commas. Two: Navoi, which is in the desert, is very hot. Three: no commas. Four: My grandfather, who was born in nineteen forty, loves chess.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: vergul yo‘q. Ikki: Navoiy, u cho‘lda joylashgan, juda issiq. Uch: vergul yo‘q. To‘rt: Bobom, u 1940-yilda tug‘ilgan, shaxmatni yaxshi ko‘radi.

scenes.title: Predlog gap oxirida
board: the house I grew up in
the people I live with
formal: the house in which I grew up

examples.t: This is the house I grew up in.
Who's the person you were talking to?
the topic which I'm interested in

scenes.say_native: Endi so‘z tartibining eng g‘alati qismi: predlog. Ingliz tilida “grow up in”, “live with”, “talk to”, “be interested in” kabi fe’llar predlog bilan birga keladi. Nisbiy gapda bu predlog odatda gapning oxirida qoladi: “the house I grew up in”, “the person you were talking to”. O‘zbekchada predlog emas, kelishik qo‘shimchasi bor: “men o‘sgan uy”. Shuning uchun predlogni unutib qo‘yish oson. Rasmiy yozuvda predlog oldinga chiqadi: “the house in which I grew up”, lekin og‘zaki nutqda oxirida qoldiring.
scenes.say: In everyday English, the preposition goes at the end of the clause. This is the house I grew up in. Who's the person you were talking to? In formal writing, you might see: the house in which I grew up.
scenes.say_uz: Kundalik ingliz tilida predlog gapning oxiriga boradi. Bu men o‘sgan uy. Siz gaplashayotgan odam kim? Rasmiy yozuvda shunday ko‘rishingiz mumkin: men o‘sgan uy.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: pauza va that
board: that → weak /ðət/
the film that we watched → /ðə fɪlm ðət wi ˈwɒtʃt/
commas → short pauses ↘

examples.t: My sister, | who's a nurse, | works at night.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida ikki gap. Birinchidan, nisbiy olmosh sifatidagi “that” kuchsiz shaklda aytiladi: /ðət/, unli qisqa va noaniq. “The film that we watched” tez aytilganda “that” deyarli eshitilmaydi. Ikkinchidan, vergulli gaplarda vergul o‘rnida qisqa pauza qilinadi va qo‘shimcha ma’lumot odatda pastroq, tezroq ohangda aytiladi, xuddi qavs ichidagidek. “My sister, who’s a nurse, works at night”. Vergulsiz gaplarda esa pauza yo‘q, hammasi bitta oqimda aytiladi.
scenes.say: In defining clauses, say it all in one flow and use the weak form of that. The film that we watched. In non-defining clauses, pause at the commas. My sister, who's a nurse, works at night.
scenes.say_uz: Aniqlovchi gaplarda hammasini bir oqimda ayting va that ning kuchsiz shaklini ishlating. Biz ko‘rgan film. Vergulli gaplarda vergulda pauza qiling. Opam, u hamshira, kechasi ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Takrorlang: ohang bilan
board: The book that I bought was cheap.
My uncle, who lives in Andijan, is a farmer.
This is the place where I was born.
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Uchta gapni eshitasiz. Birinchi va uchinchisida pauza qilmang, “that” ni kuchsiz ayting. Ikkinchisida esa vergul joylarida qisqa pauza qiling va “who lives in Andijan” qismini biroz pastroq ohangda ayting. Har bir gapni ikki marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Repeat after me. The book that I bought was cheap. My uncle, who lives in Andijan, is a farmer. This is the place where I was born.
scenes.say_uz: Mendan keyin takrorlang. Men sotib olgan kitob arzon edi. Amakim, u Andijonda yashaydi, dehqon. Bu men tug‘ilgan joy.

scenes.title: Qanday eshitilishi kerak
board: the book_that_I bought → one flow
My uncle | who lives in Andijan | is a farmer
where I was born → ↘ falling at the end
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Birinchi gapda “the book that I bought” bitta oqimda, so‘zlar bir-biriga ulanib aytildi, “that” deyarli /ðət/ bo‘lib eshitildi. Ikkinchi gapda “My uncle” dan keyin to‘xtam, keyin qo‘shimcha ma’lumot, yana to‘xtam va “is a farmer”. Uchinchi gapda “where I was born” oxirida ovoz pasaydi, chunki bu oddiy darak gap. Agar o‘zingizni yozib olib tinglasangiz, farqni yanada aniq sezasiz.
scenes.say: Well done. In the first sentence, no pauses at all. In the second, two short pauses at the commas. In the third, your voice goes down at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla. Birinchi gapda umuman pauza yo‘q. Ikkinchisida vergullarda ikkita qisqa pauza. Uchinchisida ovozingiz oxirida pasayadi.

scenes.title: Gaplarni birlashtirish: 3 qadam
board: 1) find the shared noun (umumiy ot)
2) replace he/it/there → who/which/where
3) put the clause right after the noun

examples.t: I met a woman. She speaks Korean.
examples.uz: Bir ayol bilan tanishdim. U koreys tilida gapiradi.

examples.t: → I met a woman who speaks Korean.
examples.uz: → Koreys tilida gapiradigan ayol bilan tanishdim.

scenes.say_native: Darsning to‘rtinchi qismi: ikki gapni birlashtirish. Bu yozuv va nutqni ravon qiladigan eng foydali ko‘nikma. Uch qadam bor. Birinchi: ikkala gapdagi umumiy otni toping, masalan “a woman” va “she”. Ikkinchi: ikkinchi gapdagi olmoshni “who”, “which”, “whose” yoki “where” bilan almashtiring. Uchinchi: hosil bo‘lgan nisbiy gapni otdan darhol keyin qo‘ying. Natija: “I met a woman who speaks Korean”. Olmoshni o‘chirishni unutmang.
scenes.say: To combine two sentences, find the shared noun, replace the pronoun with who, which or where, and put the clause right after the noun. I met a woman. She speaks Korean. I met a woman who speaks Korean.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki gapni birlashtirish uchun umumiy otni toping, olmoshni who, which yoki where bilan almashtiring va gapni otdan darhol keyin qo‘ying. Bir ayol bilan tanishdim. U koreys tilida gapiradi. Koreys tilida gapiradigan ayol bilan tanishdim.

scenes.title: Birlashtirish misollari
board: The laptop is new. I use it every day. → The laptop (that) I use every day is new.
Aziz is my neighbour. His son is a pilot. → Aziz, whose son is a pilot, is my neighbour.

examples.t: The restaurant was great. We had dinner there. → The restaurant where we had dinner was great.
examples.uz: Biz kechki ovqat qilgan restoran ajoyib edi.

scenes.say_native: Uchta misolni birga ko‘rib chiqamiz. Birinchisida nisbiy gap gapning o‘rtasiga tushdi: “The laptop I use every day is new”. Bu juda muhim: nisbiy gap egadan keyin kelsa, u ega va fe’l orasida turadi. Ikkinchisida “his son” “whose son” ga aylandi va Aziz aniq odam bo‘lgani uchun vergul qo‘ydik. Uchinchisida “there” “where” ga aylandi. Har safar olmosh yoki “there” so‘zi o‘chirildi va o‘rniga nisbiy so‘z keldi.
scenes.say: The laptop I use every day is new. Aziz, whose son is a pilot, is my neighbour. The restaurant where we had dinner was great.
scenes.say_uz: Har kuni ishlatadigan noutbukim yangi. Aziz, uning o‘g‘li uchuvchi, mening qo‘shnim. Biz kechki ovqat qilgan restoran ajoyib edi.

scenes.title: Gap o‘rtasida qolib ketish
board: ✗ The laptop is new that I use every day.
✓ The laptop that I use every day is new.
✗ The restaurant where we had dinner there…
✓ The restaurant where we had dinner…
scenes.say_native: Birlashtirishda ikki xato tez-tez uchraydi. Birinchisi: nisbiy gapni otdan uzoqqa, gap oxiriga qo‘yish. “The laptop is new that I use every day” noto‘g‘ri, chunki “that” “new” so‘ziga tegishli bo‘lib qoladi. Nisbiy gap o‘zi tasvirlayotgan otga yopishib turishi kerak. Ikkinchi xato: “where” bilan birga “there” ni ham qoldirish. “Where” ning o‘zi “there” degani, ikkalasi birga kelmaydi. Xuddi shu qoida “which” va “it” uchun ham amal qiladi.
scenes.say: Keep the clause next to its noun. The laptop that I use every day is new. And don't keep there after where: the restaurant where we had dinner.
scenes.say_uz: Nisbiy gapni o‘z otining yonida saqlang. Har kuni ishlatadigan noutbukim yangi. Where dan keyin there ni qoldirmang: biz kechki ovqat qilgan restoran.

scenes.title: Birlashtiring
board: 1. I have a cousin. She works in Dubai.
2. This is the park. I run there every morning.
3. Bobur Mirzo wrote the Baburnama. He was born in Andijan.
4. Where's the cake? I made it yesterday.
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtta juftlikni bitta gapga birlashtiring. Uch qadamni eslang: umumiy ot, olmoshni almashtirish, gapni otdan keyin qo‘yish. Uchinchi gapda diqqat qiling: Bobur Mirzo aniq tarixiy shaxs, demak vergul kerak bo‘ladi. Pauza vaqtida gaplarni ovoz chiqarib ayting yoki daftaringizga yozing.
scenes.say: Combine the sentences. One: I have a cousin. She works in Dubai. Two: This is the park. I run there every morning. Three: Babur wrote the Baburnama. He was born in Andijan. Four: Where's the cake? I made it yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni birlashtiring. Bir: Amakivachcham bor. U Dubayda ishlaydi. Ikki: Bu park. Men u yerda har tong yuguraman. Uch: Bobur Boburnomani yozgan. U Andijonda tug‘ilgan. To‘rt: Tort qayerda? Uni kecha pishirdim.

scenes.title: Javoblar: birlashtirish
board: 1. I have a cousin who works in Dubai.
2. This is the park where I run every morning.
3. Babur, who was born in Andijan, wrote the Baburnama.
4. Where's the cake (that) I made yesterday?
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi: “She” “who” ga aylandi: “I have a cousin who works in Dubai”. Ikkinchi: “there” “where” ga: “This is the park where I run every morning”. Uchinchi: Bobur yagona shaxs, shuning uchun vergul: “Babur, who was born in Andijan, wrote the Baburnama”. To‘rtinchi: “it” to‘ldiruvchi edi, shuning uchun “that” ni tashlab ketish ham mumkin: “Where’s the cake I made yesterday?” Agar to‘rttasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz endi murakkab gaplar tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: One: I have a cousin who works in Dubai. Two: This is the park where I run every morning. Three: Babur, who was born in Andijan, wrote the Baburnama. Four: Where's the cake I made yesterday?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Dubayda ishlaydigan amakivachcham bor. Ikki: Bu men har tong yuguradigan park. Uch: Andijonda tug‘ilgan Bobur Boburnomani yozgan. To‘rt: Kecha pishirgan tortim qayerda?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Suratlar
board: Listen: Malika & Tom
Who is who in the photo?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Malika do‘sti Tomga to‘y suratlarini ko‘rsatyapti. Tinglayotganda nisbiy gaplarga e’tibor bering: who, whose, where va olmoshsiz shakllar. Keyin sizga uchta savol beraman, shuning uchun suratdagi har bir odam kim ekanini eslab qoling. Kim qayerda turibdi, kim nima qiladi. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Tom: Is this your sister's wedding? Malika: Yes! The woman who's wearing the white dress is my sister, Dilnoza. Tom: And the man next to her? Malika: That's Sardor, the man she married. Tom: Who's the guy whose tie is red? Malika: My cousin Jasur. He's the one who organised everything. Tom: And where was this? Malika: At a restaurant in Samarkand, where my parents had their wedding too.
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Bu opangning to‘yimi? Malika: Ha! Oq ko‘ylak kiygan ayol opam Dilnoza. Tom: Uning yonidagi erkak-chi? Malika: Bu Sardor, opam turmushga chiqqan odam. Tom: Galstugi qizil yigit kim? Malika: Amakivachcham Jasur. Hammasini u tashkil qilgan. Tom: Bu qayerda bo‘lgan? Malika: Samarqanddagi restoranda, ota-onamning to‘yi ham o‘sha yerda bo‘lgan.

scenes.title: Savollar: Dialog 1
board: 1. Who is wearing the white dress?
2. Who organised everything?
3. What is special about the restaurant?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Iloji bo‘lsa, javobda nisbiy gap ishlating. Masalan: “Dilnoza is the woman who…”. Birinchi savol: oq ko‘ylakda kim bor? Ikkinchi: hammasini kim tashkil qildi? Uchinchi: restoran nimasi bilan alohida? Pauza vaqtida to‘liq gaplar bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. One: Who is wearing the white dress? Two: Who organised everything? Three: What is special about the restaurant?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Bir: Oq ko‘ylakni kim kiygan? Ikki: Hammasini kim tashkil qilgan? Uch: Restoranning nimasi alohida?

scenes.title: Javoblar: Dialog 1
board: 1. Dilnoza, Malika's sister
2. Jasur, the cousin whose tie is red
3. It's the place where her parents got married too.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: oq ko‘ylakdagi ayol Malikaning opasi Dilnoza. Ikkinchi: hammasini galstugi qizil bo‘lgan amakivachcha Jasur tashkil qildi: “Jasur is the cousin whose tie is red”. Uchinchi: bu restoranda Malikaning ota-onasining to‘yi ham bo‘lgan: “It’s the restaurant where her parents had their wedding”. Dialogdagi “the man she married” birikmasiga ham e’tibor bering: bu yerda “who” tushirib qoldirilgan, chunki undan keyin “she” keladi.
scenes.say: One: Dilnoza, Malika's sister. Two: Jasur, the cousin whose tie is red. Three: It's the restaurant where her parents had their wedding too.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Malikaning opasi Dilnoza. Ikki: galstugi qizil bo‘lgan amakivachcha Jasur. Uch: bu Malikaning ota-onasi ham to‘y qilgan restoran.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Gid bilan
board: Listen: a tour guide in Bukhara
Listen for: which, who, where, when
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Buxoroda gid bir sayyohlar guruhiga shaharni ko‘rsatyapti. Bu yerda vergulli, ya’ni qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi gaplar ko‘p bo‘ladi, chunki gid tarixiy joylar haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi. Vergul joylaridagi pauzalarni eshitishga harakat qiling. Keyin uchta savol bo‘ladi: minora qancha baland, Ismoil Somoniy kim va gid qaysi joyni eng yaxshi ko‘radi.
scenes.say: Guide: This is the Kalyan Minaret, which is about forty-five metres tall. Tourist: Who built it? Guide: It was built in eleven twenty-seven by the Karakhanids. And over there is the tomb of Ismail Samani, who ruled this region over a thousand years ago. Tourist: It's beautiful. Guide: My favourite place is Lyabi-Hauz, where people drink tea by the water in the evening, when it's cooler.
scenes.say_uz: Gid: Bu Minorai Kalon, uning balandligi qariyb qirq besh metr. Sayyoh: Uni kim qurgan? Gid: U 1127-yilda qoraxoniylar tomonidan qurilgan. Ana u yerda esa ming yildan ko‘proq vaqt oldin bu hududni boshqargan Ismoil Somoniyning maqbarasi. Sayyoh: Juda chiroyli. Gid: Mening sevimli joyim Labi Hovuz, u yerda odamlar kechqurun, havo salqinroq bo‘lganda, suv bo‘yida choy ichadi.

scenes.title: Savollar: Dialog 2
board: 1. How tall is the Kalyan Minaret?
2. Who was Ismail Samani?
3. What do people do at Lyabi-Hauz?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: Minorai Kalon qancha baland? Ikkinchi: Ismoil Somoniy kim bo‘lgan? Javobni “He was a man who…” bilan boshlang. Uchinchi: Labi Hovuzda odamlar nima qiladi va qachon? Pauza vaqtida to‘liq javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. One: How tall is the Kalyan Minaret? Two: Who was Ismail Samani? Three: What do people do at Lyabi-Hauz, and when?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Bir: Minorai Kalon qancha baland? Ikki: Ismoil Somoniy kim bo‘lgan? Uch: Labi Hovuzda odamlar nima qiladi va qachon?

scenes.title: Javoblar: Dialog 2
board: 1. about 45 metres
2. a ruler who governed the region 1,000+ years ago
3. they drink tea by the water in the evening
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: minora taxminan qirq besh metr. Ikkinchi: Ismoil Somoniy ming yildan ko‘proq oldin bu hududni boshqargan hukmdor: “He was a ruler who governed this region”. Uchinchi: odamlar kechqurun, havo salqin bo‘lganda, suv bo‘yida choy ichadi. Gidning gaplarida vergulli tuzilmalarga e’tibor bering: “the Kalyan Minaret, which…”, “Ismail Samani, who…”, “Lyabi-Hauz, where…”. Hammasi aniq, yagona joy yoki odam, shuning uchun vergul qo‘yilgan.
scenes.say: One: about forty-five metres. Two: a ruler who governed the region over a thousand years ago. Three: they drink tea by the water in the evening, when it's cooler.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: taxminan qirq besh metr. Ikki: ming yildan ko‘proq oldin hududni boshqargan hukmdor. Uch: kechqurun, havo salqinroq bo‘lganda, suv bo‘yida choy ichishadi.

scenes.title: So‘zni ta’riflash usuli
board: A ___ is a person who …
A ___ is a thing / a machine which …
A ___ is a place where …

examples.t: A pharmacist is a person who sells medicine.
A fridge is a machine which keeps food cold.
A library is a place where you can borrow books.
examples.uz: Kutubxona kitob olib o‘qish mumkin bo‘lgan joy.

scenes.say_native: Endi nisbiy gaplar hayotda qanchalik foydali ekanini ko‘ramiz. Biror so‘zni bilmay qolsangiz yoki uni tushuntirishingiz kerak bo‘lsa, shu uchta qolip yordam beradi. “A person who…” odam uchun, “a thing which…” narsa uchun, “a place where…” joy uchun. Ingliz tilidagi izohli lug‘atlar ham aynan shunday ta’rif beradi. Bu uy vazifangiz uchun ham kerak bo‘ladi, shuning uchun qoliplarni yaxshilab eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Relative clauses are perfect for definitions. A pharmacist is a person who sells medicine. A fridge is a machine which keeps food cold. A library is a place where you can borrow books.
scenes.say_uz: Nisbiy gaplar ta’rif berish uchun juda qulay. Farmatsevt dori sotadigan odam. Muzlatkich ovqatni sovuq saqlaydigan mashina. Kutubxona kitob olib o‘qish mumkin bo‘lgan joy.

scenes.title: Ta’riflang
board: 1. a dentist
2. an airport
3. a key
4. an orphan (whose…)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta so‘zni nisbiy gap bilan ta’riflang. Uchta qolipdan foydalaning: odam, narsa yoki joy. To‘rtinchi so‘z biroz qiyinroq: “an orphan”, ya’ni yetim. Uni “whose” bilan ta’riflashga harakat qiling. Pauza vaqtida to‘rttasini ham baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Define these words. One: a dentist. Two: an airport. Three: a key. Four: an orphan. Try to use whose.
scenes.say_uz: Bu so‘zlarni ta’riflang. Bir: tish shifokori. Ikki: aeroport. Uch: kalit. To‘rt: yetim. Whose dan foydalanishga harakat qiling.

scenes.title: Namuna ta’riflar
board: 1. a person who looks after your teeth
2. a place where planes take off and land
3. a thing which opens a door
4. a child whose parents have died
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Tish shifokori: “a person who looks after people’s teeth”. Aeroport: “a place where planes take off and land”. Kalit: “a small thing which you use to open a door” yoki “a thing that opens a lock”. Yetim: “a child whose parents have died”. Sizning javoblaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi: to‘g‘ri nisbiy so‘z va otdan keyin to‘liq gap. Aytgancha, “take off” va “land” uchish va qo‘nish ma’nosida, bu foydali iboralar.
scenes.say: A dentist is a person who looks after people's teeth. An airport is a place where planes take off and land. A key is a small thing which you use to open a door. An orphan is a child whose parents have died.
scenes.say_uz: Tish shifokori odamlarning tishlariga qaraydigan odam. Aeroport samolyotlar uchadigan va qo‘nadigan joy. Kalit eshikni ochish uchun ishlatiladigan kichik narsa. Yetim ota-onasi vafot etgan bola.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: shahringiz
board: Describe your town in 5 sentences:
a place where… / a person who… / a dish which…
one sentence with commas: …, which…
one sentence: the … I like most
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘z shahringiz yoki qishlog‘ingizni beshta gap bilan tasvirlang. Har bir gapda nisbiy gap bo‘lsin. Bitta “where” bilan joy, bitta “who” bilan odam, bitta “which” bilan taom yoki narsa. Bitta gapda vergulli tuzilma ishlating, masalan shahar nomidan keyin. Va bitta gapda olmoshsiz shakl: “the place I like most”. Bir daqiqa davomida gapiring.
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Describe your town in five sentences. Use where, who and which. Use commas in one sentence, and drop the pronoun in another. Start now!
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Shahringizni beshta gap bilan tasvirlang. Where, who va which ishlating. Bitta gapda vergul ishlating, boshqasida olmoshni tushirib qoldiring. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Fergana, which is in the east, …
a market where you can buy…
the place I like most
scenes.say_native: Namuna javobni tinglang va o‘zingiznikini solishtiring. E’tibor bering: birinchi gapda shahar nomi va vergulli gap, ikkinchisida “where”, uchinchisida “which”, to‘rtinchisida “who”, beshinchisida esa olmoshsiz shakl. Agar sizning beshta gapingizda ham to‘g‘ri nisbiy so‘z bo‘lsa va ortiqcha “it” yoki “there” qo‘shmagan bo‘lsangiz, topshiriqni a’lo bajardingiz.
scenes.say: Fergana, which is in the east of Uzbekistan, is my home town. There's a big market where you can buy amazing fruit. Fergana is famous for silk, which people make by hand. My grandmother, who still lives there, makes the best samsa. The place I like most is the central park.
scenes.say_uz: Farg‘ona, u O‘zbekistonning sharqida, mening ona shahrim. U yerda ajoyib mevalar sotib olish mumkin bo‘lgan katta bozor bor. Farg‘ona ipagi bilan mashhur, uni odamlar qo‘lda tayyorlaydi. Buvim, ular hali ham u yerda yashaydi, eng zo‘r somsa pishiradi. Men eng yaxshi ko‘radigan joy markaziy park.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: who (people) · which (things) · that (both, no commas)
whose + noun · where (place) · when (time)
defining: no commas · non-defining: , who/which ,
object pronoun can be dropped: the film we watched
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Nisbiy gap ingliz tilida otdan keyin keladi, o‘zbekchada esa tasvir otdan oldin turadi. Odamlar uchun “who”, narsalar uchun “which”, ikkalasi uchun “that”. Egalik uchun “whose”, joy uchun “where”, vaqt uchun “when”. Aniqlovchi gapda vergul yo‘q, qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beruvchi gapda vergul bor va “that” ishlatilmaydi. Olmoshdan keyin yangi ega kelsa, uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin. Predlog gap oxirida qoladi va ortiqcha “it” qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say: Great job today! You can now describe people, things and places with relative clauses, use commas correctly, and combine short sentences into longer ones.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ajoyib ishladingiz! Endi odamlar, narsalar va joylarni nisbiy gaplar bilan tasvirlay olasiz, vergulni to‘g‘ri qo‘yasiz va qisqa gaplarni uzunroq gaplarga birlashtirasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Define 8 words with relative clauses
person who · thing which · place where · whose
Next: giving and supporting opinions
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Sakkizta so‘zni nisbiy gaplar yordamida inglizcha ta’riflang. Ulardan kamida ikkitasi odam, ikkitasi narsa, ikkitasi joy bo‘lsin va kamida bittasida “whose” ishlating. Masalan: “A chef is a person who cooks in a restaurant”. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: sakkiz gapning hammasida to‘g‘ri nisbiy so‘z bor, ortiqcha “he” yoki “it” yo‘q. Keyingi darsda fikr bildirish va uni dalillar bilan asoslashni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Your homework: define eight words using relative clauses. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: sakkizta so‘zni nisbiy gaplar yordamida ta’riflang. Keyingi safar ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Sakkizta so‘zni inglizcha nisbiy gaplar bilan ta’riflang: kamida ikkitasi odam (a person who…), ikkitasi narsa (a thing which…), ikkitasi joy (a place where…) va kamida bittasida whose ishlating. Mezon: har bir gapda to‘g‘ri nisbiy so‘z bor, odam uchun which ishlatilmagan, ortiqcha he/it/there yo‘q.

options: The man who he lives next door is a doctor.
The man which lives next door is a doctor.
The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The man lives next door is a doctor.
quiz.why_uz: Odam uchun who, undan keyin ortiqcha he qo‘shilmaydi va ega bo‘lgan olmoshni tashlab bo‘lmaydi.

quiz.q: I lost the book ___ you gave me.
options: what
who
that
where
quiz.why_uz: Narsa uchun that yoki which. Otdan keyin what ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.q: That's the woman ___ son won the competition.
options: who
whose
who's
which

quiz.q: This is the village ___ my grandparents live.
options: which
where
when
who
Tashkent, that is the capital, is huge.
Tashkent, which is the capital, is huge.
Tashkent which is the capital is huge.
Tashkent, what is the capital, is huge.
quiz.why_uz: Vergulli gapda faqat which/who, that ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.q: In which sentence can you leave out the relative pronoun?
options: The girl who sings in the choir is my sister.
The phone that I bought is broken.
The bus which goes to the airport is late.
My dad, who is 60, still works.
quiz.why_uz: That dan keyin yangi ega (I) keladi: the phone I bought.

quiz.q: “My sister, who lives in Seoul, is a nurse.” What does this tell us?
options: I have several sisters.
I have only one sister.
My sister is not a nurse.
Seoul is my home town.
quiz.why_uz: Vergul qo‘shimcha ma’lumotni bildiradi: opa-singil bitta.

quiz.q: Combine: “This is the house. I grew up in it.”
options: This is the house I grew up in it.
This is the house where I grew up in.
This is the house I grew up in.
This is the house which I grew up.
quiz.why_uz: Predlog oxirida qoladi, it olib tashlanadi. Where bilan in ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.q: She won the lottery, ___ changed her life.
options: that
what
which
who

quiz.q: Choose the best definition of “a librarian”.
options: A librarian is a place where you read books.
A librarian is a person who works in a library.
A librarian is a person which works in a library.
A librarian is a person works in a library.
quiz.why_uz: Odam uchun a person who + fe’l.
